text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} is having a normal, peaceful day when 
Hatsune rushes over, looking very pale.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつも通り平和な日々を送っていた{0}のところに、
ハツネが血相を変えてやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}, I'm so glad I finally found you!
This is bad! This is really bad!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、やっと見つけたー！
大変だよ、大変！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I had a prophetic dream!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私ね、
予知夢を見たの！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Do you know what those are? It's when you have a dream that
predicts the future!
choice_data_list: I've had dreams like that before.
That sounds like a superpower you'd have.
text_block_list.orig_text:
予知夢ってわかるかな？
未来のことを、
夢で見ちゃう超能力なんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Really?! You've got superpowers too?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当！？
{0}くんも超能力者だったの！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You had a dream about curry, so you had curry for lunch?
Th-that doesn't count at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……カレーの夢を見たから、
お昼はカレーにした？
そ、
そういうのは予知夢じゃないよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Prophetic dreams are a kind of superpower too,
so any time I have them, I wake up exhausted and just go right
back to sleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう！
予知夢で超能力を使っちゃうから、
起きた途端に眠くなっちゃって、
二度寝しちゃうんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wait! Now's not the time to talk about that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って！
そんな話をしている場合じゃないんだよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Listen! Landosol's in danger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね！　
ランドソルが無くなっちゃうの！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in my dream! A meteor's going to come crashing down on
Landosol. And I mean, a [i]huge[/i] one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
予知夢で見ちゃったの！
今夜、ランドソルに隕石が落ちてくるんだよ！
ものすっごく、
でっかいヤツ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You... probably don't believe me, huh? It's so completely
off-the-wall...
choice_data_list: I kinda do and kinda don't.
text_block_list.orig_text:
って言っても、
{0}くんだって信じられないよね？
こんな突飛な話……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Thank you! You really are the greatest friend I could
ever ask for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと！　
ありがとー！！
やっぱり{0}くんは、
最高の友だちだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
So you kinda believe me then?
Heehee. That's good enough for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
半分は信じてくれるってこと？
えへへ、
それだけでもうれしいなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
S-so what are we gonna do? If there really is a meteor coming,
then everyone here is in danger... They're all going to
lose their home! It's just so horrible...
choice_data_list: Can we at least evacuate everyone?
Is there any way to destroy the meteor?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも、
どうしよう？
そんなことになったら、
みんな困るよね……
大好きな街がなくなっちゃうなんて、
悲しいよ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If we can at least get the people to safety,
then... Wait, but nobody's going to believe me, are they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
せめて、
街の人たちだけでも避難を──
……でも、
こんな話、
信じてもらえないよね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I can't tell them about my superpowers... Even if I could,
there's no guarantee they'd believe that, either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の力のことを言いふらすわけにもいかないし……
もし超能力の話をしても、
信じてもらえるかわからないし……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How are we supposed to do that? There's no way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？　
どうやって？
そんなの無理だと思うけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
What is it? You have an idea? Huh? You want me to think back to
that time I got more sleep than usual?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なになに？　
なにかひらめいたの！？
え？　
この前、
たっぷり寝た時？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! If I get tons of sleep like before, my
superpowers get overcharged!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
そうか！
この間みたいに、
たっくさん寝れば、
すっごい超能力が使えるかもっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? Maybe I [i]can[/i] destroy a meteor! And even if I can't,
I can at least change its trajectory, right? That way, it won't
crash into the town!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしたら隕石だって壊せるかも！？
もし壊せなかったとしても、
軌道を変えられれば、
街に落ちないかも！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's a great idea! Gosh, you are such a little
smartie-pants! All right, let's get sleepin'!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
名案だよぉ！　
さっすが{0}くん！
よーし！　
さっそく準備しに行こう！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
This is my favorite spot. It feels so nice that you're asleep
before you know it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここ、
私のお気に入りの場所なんだよ。
気持ちいいから、
ぐっすり眠れるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you nap with me? I know if you're by my side,
I'll sleep even better. So... please?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
{0}くんも一緒にお昼寝しようよ。
{0}くんの隣にいると、
よく眠れるから……
ね、
いいよね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You will? Thank you! Just get on over here and lie down.
Good night, {0}. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いいの？　
　ありがとう！
ほらほら、
横になって！
{0}くん、おやすみ～♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Hnnn! What a nice nap... Yep! I'm definitely feeling
two-hundred percent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
よく寝た……
うん！　
元気200％だよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like {0} is still sleeping...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、{0}くん、
まだ寝てるんだ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You should stay here and rest. If I fail and the meteor hits,
you'll be safe out here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……キミはここで寝ててね。
もし、
私が失敗しても、
ここなら安全だと思うから。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But I'll make sure nothing goes wrong. I've got a whole town to
save! I have all the power I need. I'll protect Landosol, even
if it kills me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
絶対に成功させてみせるよ。
みんなの街を守らないと！
全力の超能力で……
私の命に代えてでもランドソルを守るよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: {0}... Thank you for always being there for me.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}くん……いつも助けてくれてありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You always looked after me when I fell asleep... and you
kept my superpowers a secret from everyone, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
眠っちゃった時に守ってくれたり、
超能力のこと隠してくれたり、
とか……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Every day I've spent with you has been amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんと一緒にいるようになってから、
毎日すっごく楽しかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And just in case...
If I can't stop the meteor and it smooshes me and the town...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁっ！　
それと、念のため！
もし私が失敗しちゃって、
隕石にペチャンコにされちゃったらぁ～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Please... take care of Shiorin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリンのこと……
よろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
She's more important to me than anyone else in the whole wide
world. I know I can count on you to keep her safe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私が一番一番、
いちば～ん大事なシオリンのこと、
{0}くんなら、安心してまかせられる……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
If you're there for her... it'll make her feel better too.
And if she's happy, then I'm happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリンの隣に{0}くんがいてくれたら、
きっとシオリンも喜んでくれると思うよ。
そしたら私も、
うれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Or so I say. I think really, I'm... a little jealous.
It kind of hurts, but just a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも……
ちょっと……
うらやましいかな……
ちょっと……
くやしいかな……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Actually... I think... it's more than just a little.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとじゃ……
ない……
かな……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: This might be the end, so I want to say it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……最後かもしれないから、
言っておくね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: {0}... I love you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私……
{0}くんのこと、
大好きだよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. Sorry I couldn't say it while you were awake.
But this is the end, so it's all I can do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えへへ。
寝てる時にいうなんて、
ずるいかな。
でも、
最後だし、
許してね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: So... I'll be going now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
行ってくるね♪

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
It's really here...! Ugh! Why couldn't this have just been a
regular dream instead of a prophetic one?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に落ちてきた……！
もう！　
予知夢なんて、
はずれてもいいのにっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
But this is fine! I got plenty of sleep, so a little meteor is
no match for me! Come get some!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
いっぱい寝たから大丈夫っ！
あんな隕石なんて、
ばばーんっと壊しちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Taaake that!
text_block_list.orig_text: えーーーーいっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Rrgh... Ggh! I-it's so heavy... I recharged so much...
My superpowers are stronger than ever before...!
So why? Why can't I break this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う……うぅっ！　
　
お、
重い……っ！
たくさんチャージして、
全力以上の力が出てるのに……！
隕石、
壊せないっ！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I-I don't know if I can keep going...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
このままじゃ……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what? It's so light all of a sudden...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？
あ、
あれ……
急に軽くなった？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: It's like my powers got a sudden boost... Wait, is this...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いきなり超能力がパワーアップして……？
これって、
もしかして……！？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: {0}! I knew it... It was you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！？
やっぱり、
これはキミの力……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't believe you... I was going to do this all alone!
I didn't want to put you in danger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もう……
一人で頑張るつもりだったのにっ！
{0}くんだけは、
来ないでほしかったのにっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: But what's done is done. Now I REALLY can't afford to fail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも、
こうなったら絶対に成功させないとだねっ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Let's blast this thing together, {0}! Ready now?!
Taaake that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒に頑張ろう、{0}くん！
いくよっ、
えぇーいっ！！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh... oh my gosh...
We did it! We destroyed the meteor!
And it's all thanks to you, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……や、
やった……
やったよ！
隕石壊せた～！
{0}くんのおかげだね☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad... The whole town is safe.
You know, I actually thought I'd never see you again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった～、
みんなの街を守れたね♪
じつは{0}くんとも、
もう二度と会えないかもって思ってて……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's why... I said all that stuff to him while he was
sleeping...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
だから、
寝てる隙に
あんなこと言っちゃったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wait... [i]Was[/i] he sleeping?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね、
寝てる隙に……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: H-hey, {0}?

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You were sleeping earlier, right?
You didn't... hear anything I said, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっき、
寝てたんだよ……
ね？
私がいったこと……
き、
聞いてないよ……
ね？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Like what? Um, w-well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにをって、
それはその……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Like how I... *yawn*
text_block_list.orig_text:
だい、
ふわぁぁぁ～～～

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Oh no... I'm getting all sleepy again... A-and I had
something really important to say, too... *yawn*
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁっ～
また……
眠くなっちゃったよぉ……
だ、
大事な話をしようとしたのに……
ふわぁぁぁ……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... {0}... Thank you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
むにゃ…………
{0}くん……
ありがとうね……
